      confirmed: req.header('X-Confirm-Duplication-Risk') === 'true', validateActorInTransaction: (tx) => this.currentActorHasGrant(req, conversa.buId, tx),
      auditInTransaction: (tx) => this.registro.registrar(tx, req.usuario!.mantenedoraId, 'atendimento.dispatch.risk_acknowledged', ator(req), { buId: conversa.buId, entidadeId: admissionId }) });
  }

  private initialMessageRequest(body: Record<string, unknown>, includeFingerprint: true): InitialMessageRequest;
  private initialMessageRequest(body: Record<string, unknown>, includeFingerprint: false): InitialMessagePreviewRequest;
  private initialMessageRequest(body: Record<string, unknown>, includeFingerprint: boolean): InitialMessageRequest | InitialMessagePreviewRequest {
    if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'REQUISICAO_INVALIDA' });
    const allowed = ['channelId', 'expectedGeneration', 'mensagem', ...(includeFingerprint ? ['previewFingerprint'] : [])];
    if (Object.keys(body).some((key) => !allowed.includes(key)) || typeof body.channelId !== 'string'
      || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(body.channelId)
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(body.expectedGeneration) || (body.expectedGeneration as number) < 1
      || includeFingerprint && (typeof body.previewFingerprint !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(body.previewFingerprint))) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'REQUISICAO_INVALIDA' });
    }
    const message = body.mensagem;
    if (!message || typeof message !== 'object' || Array.isArray(message)) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'REQUISICAO_INVALIDA' });
    const row = message as Record<string, unknown>;
    const base = { channelId: body.channelId, expectedGeneration: body.expectedGeneration as number };
    const preview = includeFingerprint ? { previewFingerprint: body.previewFingerprint as string } : {};
    if (row.tipo === 'TEXTO') {
      if (Object.keys(row).some((key) => !['tipo', 'texto'].includes(key)) || typeof row.texto !== 'string'
        || !row.texto.trim() || [...row.texto].length > 4096) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'REQUISICAO_INVALIDA' });
      return { ...base, kind: 'text' as const, text: row.texto, ...preview };
    }
    if (row.tipo !== 'TEMPLATE' || Object.keys(row).some((key) => !['tipo', 'templateId', 'language', 'catalogAfter', 'expectedDefinitionFingerprint', 'parameters'].includes(key))
      || typeof row.templateId !== 'string' || !row.templateId || row.templateId.length > 128
      || typeof row.language !== 'string' || !row.language || row.language.length > 16
      || row.catalogAfter !== undefined && (typeof row.catalogAfter !== 'string' || row.catalogAfter.length < 1 || row.catalogAfter.length > 512)
      || typeof row.expectedDefinitionFingerprint !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(row.expectedDefinitionFingerprint)
      || !row.parameters || typeof row.parameters !== 'object'
      || Array.isArray(row.parameters) && (row.parameters.length > 20 || row.parameters.some((value) => typeof value !== 'string' || !value || [...value].length > 1024))
      || !Array.isArray(row.parameters) && (Object.keys(row.parameters as object).length > 20 || Object.values(row.parameters as Record<string, unknown>).some((value) => typeof value !== 'string' || !value || [...value].length > 1024))) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'REQUISICAO_INVALIDA' });
    }
    return { ...base, kind: 'approved-template' as const, remoteTemplateId: row.templateId, language: row.language,
      catalogAfter: typeof row.catalogAfter === 'string' ? row.catalogAfter : null,
      expectedDefinitionFingerprint: row.expectedDefinitionFingerprint,
      values: row.parameters as Record<string, string> | string[], ...preview };
  }

  private assertEmptyBody(body: unknown): void {
    if (body !== undefined && (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body) || Object.keys(body).length !== 0)) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'REQUISICAO_INVALIDA' });
    }
  }

  private assertUuid(value: string): void {
    if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(value)) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'REQUISICAO_INVALIDA' });
    }
  }

  private async currentActorHasGrant(req: Request, buId: string, tx: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<boolean> {
    const cookie = this.sessions.extrairDoCabecalho(req.headers.cookie);
    const claimsAtRequest = this.sessions.verificar(cookie);
    if (!claimsAtRequest || claimsAtRequest.uid !== req.usuario!.id) return false;
    let rows: Array<{ id: string; user_status: string; password_changed_at: Date | null;
      user_mantenedora_id: string; bu_status: string; bu_mantenedora_id: string; role: string }>;
    try {
      rows = await tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ id: string; user_status: string; password_changed_at: Date | null;
        user_mantenedora_id: string; bu_status: string; bu_mantenedora_id: string; role: string }>>`
        SELECT u.id, u.status::text AS user_status, u.password_changed_at,
          u.mantenedora_id AS user_mantenedora_id, b.status::text AS bu_status,
          b.mantenedora_id AS bu_mantenedora_id, r.role::text AS role
        FROM app_users u
        JOIN user_bu_roles r ON r.user_id = u.id AND r.bu_id = ${buId}
        JOIN business_units b ON b.id = r.bu_id
        WHERE u.id = ${claimsAtRequest.uid}
        FOR SHARE OF u, r, b NOWAIT`;
    } catch (error) {
      const candidate = error as { code?: unknown; meta?: { code?: unknown; message?: unknown }; cause?: { code?: unknown } };
      const lockCode = candidate.meta?.code ?? candidate.cause?.code ?? candidate.code;
      if (lockCode === '55P03' || candidate.meta?.message === '55P03'
        || typeof candidate.meta?.message === 'string' && candidate.meta.message.includes('55P03')) {
        throw new ConflictException({ code: 'CURRENT_GRANT_REQUIRED' });
      }
      throw error;
    }
    const current = rows[0];
    const claimsNow = this.sessions.verificar(cookie);
    return Boolean(current && claimsNow && claimsNow.uid === claimsAtRequest.uid
      && claimsNow.iat === claimsAtRequest.iat && claimsNow.exp === claimsAtRequest.exp
      && claimsNow.exp > Date.now() && current.user_status === 'ATIVO'
      && current.bu_status === 'ATIVO' && current.user_mantenedora_id === current.bu_mantenedora_id
      && (!current.password_changed_at || current.password_changed_at.getTime() <= claimsNow.iat)
      && ['ATENDENTE', 'ADMIN', 'OWNER'].includes(current.role));
  }

  /** New initial-contact routes require the actor's home tenant to match the BU. */
  private async assertActorTenant(req: Request, buId: string): Promise<void> {
    const rows = await this.prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ user_id: string; user_mantenedora_id: string; bu_mantenedora_id: string; user_status: string; bu_status: string }>>`
      SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.mantenedora_id AS user_mantenedora_id,
        b.mantenedora_id AS bu_mantenedora_id, u.status::text AS user_status,
        b.status::text AS bu_status
      FROM app_users u CROSS JOIN business_units b
      WHERE u.id = ${req.usuario!.id} AND b.id = ${buId}`;
    const row = rows[0];
    if (!row || row.user_status !== 'ATIVO' || row.bu_status !== 'ATIVO'
      || row.user_mantenedora_id !== row.bu_mantenedora_id) throw new NotFoundException();
  }

  @Get('business-units/:buId/conversations')
  async listar(
    @Param('buId') buId: string,
    @Query() q: Record<string, string>,
    @Req() req: Request,
  ) {
    // Estar no escopo BASTA: com o eixo de capacidades dissolvido (ADR-0018 §3),
    // quem tem grant na BU atende as conversas dela. Era isso que a capacidade
    // ATENDIMENTO dizia, e agora quem diz é o papel.
    await exigirPapelNaBu(this.access, req.usuario!.id, buId, 'ATENDENTE');

    const aba = q.aba?.toUpperCase();
    const r = await this.conversas.listar(buId, {
      grupos: aba === 'GRUPO',
      status: ABAS.includes(aba as (typeof ABAS)[number]) ? aba : undefined,
      minhas: q.minhas === 'true' ? req.usuario!.id : undefined,
      pagina: q.pagina ? Number(q.pagina) : undefined,
      limite: q.limite ? Number(q.limite) : undefined,
    });
    // O setor sobe achatado, como a tela o consome (`conversa.setor`).
    return {
      total: r.total,
      pagina: r.pagina,
      temMais: r.temMais,
      conversations: r.conversas.map(({ bu, ...c }) => ({ ...c, setor: bu.setor.name })),
    };
  }

  @Get('conversations/:id/messages')
  async thread(@Param('id') id: string, @Query() q: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const { conversa } = await this.resolver(id, req);
    // Validar somente depois do resolver: recurso fora do escopo permanece 404,
    // mesmo quando os parâmetros enviados são inválidos.
    const consulta = validarConsultaTimeline(q);
    const timeline = await this.conversas.timeline(
      conversa.id, consulta.limite, consulta.antes, consulta.marcarLida,
    );

    const janela = await this.conversas.estadoDaJanela(conversa.id, conversa.buId);
    return {
      conversa: {
        id: conversa.id,
        contato: conversa.contact,
        nome: conversa.displayName,
        status: conversa.status,
        atendente: conversa.attendantName,
      },
      // O front precisa saber que "responder" pode estar indisponível, e por quê.
      janela: {
        exigida: janela.exigeJanela,
        aberta: janela.aberta,
        expiraEm: janela.expiraEm,
        canal: janela.canal?.type ?? null,
        disponivel: janela.disponivel,
        motivo: janela.motivoIndisponibilidade,
      },
      messages: timeline.messages,
      paginacao: timeline.paginacao,
    };
  }

  @Post('conversations/:id/messages')
  @HttpCode(201)
  async responder(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const { conversa } = await this.resolver(id, req);

    const allowed = ['texto', 'schemaVersion', 'routeId', 'channelId', 'expectedGeneration', 'contextFingerprint'];
    if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || body.schemaVersion !== 2 || Object.keys(body).length !== allowed.length
      || Object.keys(body).some((key) => !allowed.includes(key)) || typeof body.routeId !== 'string'
      || typeof body.channelId !== 'string' || !Number.isSafeInteger(body.expectedGeneration)
      || typeof body.contextFingerprint !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(body.contextFingerprint)) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'REQUISICAO_INVALIDA' });
    }
    const routeSelection = { routeId: body.routeId, channelId: body.channelId,
      expectedGeneration: body.expectedGeneration as number, contextFingerprint: body.contextFingerprint };

    const texto = String(body?.texto ?? '').trim();
    if (!texto) throw new BadRequestException({ error: 'Escreva uma mensagem.', code: 'TEXTO_VAZIO' });
    const selectedOrigin = await this.prisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: { id: routeSelection.channelId, buId: conversa.buId }, select: { type: true } });
    const maxLength = selectedOrigin?.type === 'INSTAGRAM' ? 1000 : 4096;
    if (Array.from(texto).length > maxLength) throw new BadRequestException({ error: 'Mensagem muito longa.', code: 'TEXTO_LONGO' });

    await this.initialMessages.assertOrdinaryDispatchAllowed(conversa.id, conversa.buId);

    const m = await this.conversas.responder(conversa.id, conversa.buId, texto, {
      kind: 'BFF',
      userId: req.usuario!.id,
      name: req.usuario!.nome,
    }, routeSelection);
    return { id: m.id, canal: m.channelOrigin, em: m.createdAt };
  }

  @Post('conversations/:id/claim')
  async assumir(@Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    const { conversa } = await this.resolver(id, req);

    const c = await this.conversas.assumir(conversa.id, { userId: req.usuario!.id, nome: req.usuario!.nome });
    await this.registro.registrarSolto(req.usuario!.mantenedoraId, 'atendimento.assumido', ator(req), {
      buId: conversa.buId,
      entidadeId: conversa.id,
      frase: { contato: conversa.contact },
    });
    return { id: c.id, status: c.status, atendente: c.attendantName };
  }

  @Post('conversations/:id/close')
  async finalizar(@Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    const { conversa } = await this.resolver(id, req);

    const c = await this.conversas.finalizar(conversa.id);
    await this.registro.registrarSolto(req.usuario!.mantenedoraId, 'atendimento.encerrado', ator(req), {
      buId: conversa.buId,
      entidadeId: conversa.id,
      frase: { contato: conversa.contact },
    });
    return { id: c.id, status: c.status };
  }

  /** Escopo primeiro: fora dele, 404 — inclusive para BU de outra Mantenedora. */
  private async resolver(conversaId: string, req: Request) {
    const escopo = await this.access.escopo(req.usuario!.id);
    const conversa = await this.conversas.carregarNoEscopo(conversaId, escopo);
    const bu = await exigirPapelNaBu(this.access, req.usuario!.id, conversa.buId, 'ATENDENTE');
    return { conversa, papel: bu.papel };
  }
}

import {
  BadRequestException,
  Body,
  Controller,
  ForbiddenException,
  Get,
  HttpCode,
  NotFoundException,
  Param,
  Patch,
  Post,
  Req,
  Res,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { AccessService } from '../../domain/access/access.service';
import { atLeast } from '../../domain/access/role';
import { TenancyService } from '../../domain/tenancy/tenancy.service';
import { IdentityService } from '../../domain/identity/identity.service';
import { PasswordService } from '../../domain/identity/password.service';
import { SessionService } from '../../infra/session/session.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { ModulosService } from '../../domain/produto/modulos.service';
import { SetorService } from '../../domain/setor/setor.service';
import { ator } from './setores.controller';

@Controller('api/bff/me')
export class MeController {
  constructor(
    private readonly access: AccessService,
    private readonly identity: IdentityService,
    private readonly passwords: PasswordService,
    private readonly sessions: SessionService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly modulos: ModulosService,
  ) {}

  @Get()
  async me(@Req() req: Request) {
    const u = req.usuario!;
    const mantenedora = await this.prisma.mantenedora.findUnique({
      where: { id: u.mantenedoraId },
      select: { id: true, name: true },
    });

    return {
      id: u.id,
      nome: u.nome,
      email: u.email,
      precisaTrocarSenha: u.precisaTrocarSenha,
      mantenedora,
      // Papel na Mantenedora é CALCULADO a cada leitura, nunca armazenado.
      papel: await this.access.papelNaMantenedoraDoUsuario(u.id, u.mantenedoraId),
      escopo: await this.access.escopo(u.id),
      // O que ESTA instalação e ESTA Mantenedora oferecem, já interseccionado
      // (ADR-0016 §6). O front monta o roteador a partir daqui: módulo desligado
      // não é escondido por CSS, a rota não é montada.
      produto: await this.modulos.produto(u.mantenedoraId),
      ...(await this.identity.perfil(u.id)),
    };
  }

  /**
   * O perfil da própria pessoa (o "Meu perfil" do desenho).
   *
   * **O e-mail não é editável aqui.** Ele é a identidade de login, único dentro
   * da Mantenedora (ADR-0008 §3), e trocá-lo por conta própria é trocar de quem
   * se é — não é ajuste de cadastro. Quem muda é `ADMIN`, pela tela de Pessoas.
   */
  @Patch()
  async atualizarPerfil(
    @Body() body: { nome?: string; telefone?: string; avatar?: string | null },
    @Req() req: Request,
  ) {
    const nome = typeof body?.nome === 'string' ? body.nome.trim() : undefined;
    if (nome !== undefined && !nome) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ error: 'O nome não pode ficar vazio.', code: 'PAYLOAD_INVALIDO' });
    }
    return this.identity.atualizarPerfil(req.usuario!.id, {
      nome,
      telefone: typeof body?.telefone === 'string' ? body.telefone.trim() : undefined,
      avatar: body?.avatar === null || typeof body?.avatar === 'string' ? body.avatar : undefined,
    });
  }

  @Post('password')
  @HttpCode(200)
  async trocarSenha(
    @Body() body: { atual?: string; nova?: string },
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    const u = req.usuario!;
    const atual = String(body?.atual ?? '');
    const nova = String(body?.nova ?? '');

    const invalida = this.passwords.invalida(nova);
    if (invalida) {
      res.status(400);
      return { error: invalida, code: 'SENHA_INVALIDA' };
    }
    if (atual === nova) {
      res.status(400);
      return { error: 'A nova senha precisa ser diferente da atual.', code: 'SENHA_INVALIDA' };
    }

    const ok = await this.identity.trocarPropriaSenha(u.id, atual, nova);
    if (!ok) {
      res.status(400);
      return { error: 'A senha atual está incorreta.', code: 'CREDENCIAL_INVALIDA' };
    }

    // Trocar a PRÓPRIA senha não entra no catálogo (ADR-0022 §2): é ato sobre si
    // mesmo, e `password_changed_at` testemunha. Redefinir a senha DE OUTRO
    // entra — é poder exercido sobre terceiro.

    // A troca derruba as sessões anteriores; esta ganha cookie novo para quem
    // trocou continuar logado aqui e cair nos outros dispositivos.
    res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', this.sessions.cookie(this.sessions.assinar(u.id)));
    return { ok: true };
  }
}

@Controller('api/bff/business-units')
export class BusinessUnitsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly access: AccessService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly tenancy: TenancyService,
    private readonly setores: SetorService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Conectar um número novo é ação da Mantenedora, então exige papel ADMIN
   * **nela** — que é calculado, e só existe para quem tem ADMIN em todas as BUs.
   */
  @Post()
  @HttpCode(201)
  async criar(@Body() body: { nome?: string; telefone?: string; setorId?: string }, @Req() req: Request) {
    const papel = await this.access.papelNaMantenedoraDoUsuario(req.usuario!.id, req.usuario!.mantenedoraId);
    if (!papel || !atLeast(papel, 'ADMIN')) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({
        error: 'Esta ação exige papel ADMIN na Mantenedora.',
        code: 'PAPEL_INSUFICIENTE',
      });
    }
    const nome = String(body?.nome ?? '').trim();
    if (!nome) throw new BadRequestException({ error: 'Dê um nome à Business Unit.', code: 'PAYLOAD_INVALIDO' });

    const r = await this.tenancy.criarBusinessUnit(
      req.usuario!.mantenedoraId,
      nome,
      body?.telefone,
      body?.setorId,
      ator(req),
    );
    return { id: r.bu.id, nome: r.bu.name, setor: { id: r.setor.id, nome: r.setor.name }, herdaramGrant: r.herdaram };
  }

  /** Só as BUs do escopo do usuário. Sem grant, lista vazia — nunca "todas". */
  @Get()
  async listar(@Req() req: Request) {
    const escopo = await this.access.escopo(req.usuario!.id);
    const bus = await this.prisma.businessUnit.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: escopo }, status: 'ATIVO' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        phone: true,
        setor: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
        businessChannelIdentities: { where: { platform: 'WHATSAPP' }, select: { id: true } },
        channels: { where: { type: { in: ['OFICIAL', 'NAO_OFICIAL'] }, businessIdentity: { is: { platform: 'WHATSAPP' } } }, select: {
          id: true, type: true, status: true, generation: true, currentAttemptId: true, businessIdentityId: true,
          ownNumberVerified: true, providerConnectionState: true, receiptVerifiedAt: true,
          requiresWindow: true, connectedAt: true,
        } },
      },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });
    const grants = await this.access.grantsDoUsuario(req.usuario!.id);
    const roles = new Map(grants.map((grant) => [grant.buId, grant.role]));
    return { businessUnits: bus.map((bu) => {
      const { businessChannelIdentities, channels, ...businessUnit } = bu;
      const resourceId = businessChannelIdentities.length === 1 ? businessChannelIdentities[0].id : null;
      // If ownership is conflicted, retain every WA binding so the conflict remains visible.
      const qualifiedChannels = channels.filter((channel) => !resourceId || channel.businessIdentityId === resourceId)
        .map(({ businessIdentityId: _businessIdentityId, ...channel }) => {
          void _businessIdentityId;
          return channel;
        });
      return { ...businessUnit, channels: qualifiedChannels, papel: roles.get(bu.id) ?? null };
    }) };
  }

  /** Renomear ou inativar o número. Inativar NÃO apaga: a BU é dona das conversas. */
  @Patch(':buId')
  async atualizar(
    @Param('buId') buId: string,
    @Body() body: { nome?: string; status?: 'ATIVO' | 'INATIVO' },
    @Req() req: Request,
  ) {
    const papel = await this.access.papelNaMantenedoraDoUsuario(req.usuario!.id, req.usuario!.mantenedoraId);
    if (!papel || !atLeast(papel, 'ADMIN')) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({
        error: 'Esta ação exige papel ADMIN na Mantenedora.',
        code: 'PAPEL_INSUFICIENTE',
      });
    }
    return this.tenancy.atualizarBusinessUnit(req.usuario!.mantenedoraId, buId, body ?? {}, ator(req));
  }

  /**
   * Mover o número de setor — a única escrita que reescreve permissão de gente
   * que não está na requisição (ADR-0017 §2, regra 5).
   */
  @Post(':buId/setor')
  async moverDeSetor(
    @Param('buId') buId: string,
    @Body() body: { setorId?: string },
    @Req() req: Request,
  ) {
    const papel = await this.access.papelNaMantenedoraDoUsuario(req.usuario!.id, req.usuario!.mantenedoraId);
    if (!papel || !atLeast(papel, 'ADMIN')) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({
        error: 'Esta ação exige papel ADMIN na Mantenedora.',
        code: 'PAPEL_INSUFICIENTE',
      });
    }
    const r = await this.setores.moverNumero(req.usuario!.mantenedoraId, buId, String(body?.setorId ?? ''), ator(req));
    return { setor: { id: r.setor.id, nome: r.setor.name }, concedidas: r.movidas, revogadas: r.removidas };
  }

  /**
   * BU fora do escopo responde 404, não 403 — inclusive quando ela é de outra
   * Mantenedora. Um 403 confirmaria a quem varre identificadores que o recurso
   * existe, só que alheio.
   */
  @Get(':buId')
  async detalhe(@Param('buId') buId: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    const bu = await this.access.resolverBu(req.usuario!.id, buId);
    if (!bu) throw new NotFoundException({ error: 'Não encontrado.', code: 'NAO_ENCONTRADO' });

    const [resources, bindings] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.businessChannelIdentity.findMany({ where: { buId: bu.id, platform: 'WHATSAPP' }, select: { id: true } }),
      this.prisma.buChannel.findMany({
        where: { buId: bu.id, type: { in: ['OFICIAL', 'NAO_OFICIAL'] }, businessIdentity: { is: { platform: 'WHATSAPP' } } },
        select: {
          id: true, type: true, status: true, generation: true, currentAttemptId: true, businessIdentityId: true,
          ownNumberVerified: true, providerConnectionState: true, receiptVerifiedAt: true,
          requiresWindow: true, connectedAt: true,
        },
      }),
    ]);
    const resourceId = resources.length === 1 ? resources[0].id : null;
    const canais = bindings.filter((binding) => !resourceId || binding.businessIdentityId === resourceId)
      .map(({ businessIdentityId: _businessIdentityId, ...binding }) => {
        void _businessIdentityId;
        return binding;
      });
    return { id: bu.id, nome: bu.name, papel: bu.papel, canais };
  }
}

import {
  BadRequestException,
  Body,
  Controller,
  ForbiddenException,
  Get,
  HttpCode,
  HttpException,
  Param,
  Post,
  Query,
  Req,
  Res,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { ApiKeyService } from '../../domain/integration/api-key.service';
import { RateLimitService } from '../../domain/integration/rate-limit.service';
import { ConversationsService } from '../../domain/inbox/conversations.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { resolveOrCreateContactIdentity, whatsappPeerAddress } from '../../domain/inbox/contact-identity';

const TETO = 500;

function limitePublico(valor: unknown, padrao: number): number {
  if (typeof valor !== 'string' || valor.trim() === '') return padrao;
  const numero = Number(valor);
  if (!Number.isFinite(numero) || numero <= 0) return padrao;
  const inteiro = Math.floor(numero);
  if (inteiro < 1) return padrao;
  return Math.min(inteiro, TETO);
}

/**
 * Superfície pública v1 (ADR-0010) — o contrato do parceiro.
 *
 * `account_id` continua se chamando assim e passa a valer o **UUID da BU**: o
 * parceiro já integrou esse nome com esse significado nos dois sistemas antigos,
 * e trocá-lo daria trabalho a ele sem entregar clareza.
 */
@Controller('api/v1')
export class PublicConversationsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly chaves: ApiKeyService,
    private readonly conversas: ConversationsService,
    private readonly limite: RateLimitService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
  ) {}

  @Get('accounts')
  async accounts(@Req() req: Request) {
    const ids = await this.chaves.busDaChave(req.chave!);
    const bus = await this.prisma.businessUnit.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: ids } },
      select: {
        id: true, name: true,
        businessChannelIdentities: { where: { platform: 'WHATSAPP' }, select: { id: true, externalResourceId: true } },
        channels: { where: { type: { in: ['OFICIAL', 'NAO_OFICIAL'] }, businessIdentity: { is: { platform: 'WHATSAPP' } } },
          select: { type: true, status: true, businessIdentityId: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });
    return {
      accounts: bus.flatMap((b) => {
        if (b.businessChannelIdentities.length !== 1) return [];
        const resource = b.businessChannelIdentities[0];
        return [{
          id: b.id,
          name: b.name,
          numero: resource.externalResourceId,
          canais: b.channels.filter((channel) => channel.businessIdentityId === resource.id)
            .map((c) => ({ tipo: c.type, conectado: c.status === 'CONECTADO' })),
        }];
      }),
    };
  }

  @Get('conversations')
  async conversations(@Query() q: Record<string, string>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const buId = await this.resolverConta(req, q.account_id);
    const resource = await this.whatsappResource(buId);
    if (!resource) return { conta: { id: buId }, conversations: [], truncado: false };
    const periodo = periodoDe(q.de, q.ate);
    const limite = limitePublico(q.limit, 200);
    const routeWhere = {
      platform: 'WHATSAPP' as const,
      businessIdentityId: resource.id,
      contactIdentity: { is: { platform: 'WHATSAPP' as const, namespace: 'PERSON', scopeReference: 'BU' } },
    };
    const where: Record<string, unknown> = { buId, contactType: 'PESSOA', routes: { some: routeWhere } };
    if (periodo) where.lastMessageAt = { gte: periodo.de, lte: periodo.ate };
    if (q.q?.trim()) {
      where.OR = [
        { displayName: { contains: q.q.trim(), mode: 'insensitive' } },
        { routes: { some: { ...routeWhere, contactIdentity: { is: { platform: 'WHATSAPP', namespace: 'PERSON', scopeReference: 'BU', externalPeerId: { contains: q.q.trim() } } } } } },
      ];
    }
    const linhas = await this.prisma.conversation.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: [{ lastMessageAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }],
      take: limite + 1,
      select: {
        id: true, displayName: true, status: true, attendantName: true, lastMessageAt: true, unreadCount: true,
        routes: { where: routeWhere, select: { contactIdentity: { select: { externalPeerId: true } } } },
      },
    });
    if (linhas.some((conversation) => conversation.routes.length !== 1)) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'WHATSAPP_ROUTE_AMBIGUOUS' });
    }
    const pagina = linhas.slice(0, limite);
    type LatestMessage = {
      conversationId: string;
      content: string | null;
      direction: 'IN' | 'OUT' | null;
      channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL' | 'NAO_OFICIAL' | 'INSTAGRAM' | null;
      providerResourceIdentityId: string | null;
    };
    const mensagensRecentes = pagina.length
      ? await this.prisma.$queryRaw<LatestMessage[]>`
        SELECT requested.conversation_id AS "conversationId",
          latest.content,
          latest.direction::text AS "direction",
          latest.channel_origin::text AS "channelOrigin",
          latest.provider_resource_identity_id AS "providerResourceIdentityId"
        FROM unnest(ARRAY[${Prisma.join(pagina.map((conversation) => conversation.id))}]::text[]) AS requested(conversation_id)
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT candidate.content, candidate.direction, candidate.channel_origin, candidate.provider_resource_identity_id
          FROM (
            (
              SELECT message.id, message.content, message.direction, message.channel_origin, message.provider_resource_identity_id, message.created_at
              FROM messages AS message
              WHERE message.conversation_id = requested.conversation_id AND message.direction = 'IN'
                AND message.channel_origin IN ('OFICIAL'::"ChannelType", 'NAO_OFICIAL'::"ChannelType")
                AND (message.provider_resource_identity_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM provider_resource_identities AS resource_identity
                  WHERE resource_identity.id = message.provider_resource_identity_id
                    AND resource_identity.business_identity_id = ${resource.id}
                    AND resource_identity.provider::text = message.channel_origin::text
                ))
              ORDER BY message.created_at DESC, message.id DESC
              LIMIT 1
            )
            UNION ALL
            (
              SELECT message.id, message.content, message.direction, message.channel_origin, message.provider_resource_identity_id, message.created_at
              FROM messages AS message
              WHERE message.conversation_id = requested.conversation_id AND message.direction = 'OUT'
                AND message.channel_origin IN ('OFICIAL'::"ChannelType", 'NAO_OFICIAL'::"ChannelType")
                AND (message.provider_resource_identity_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM provider_resource_identities AS resource_identity
                  WHERE resource_identity.id = message.provider_resource_identity_id
                    AND resource_identity.business_identity_id = ${resource.id}
                    AND resource_identity.provider::text = message.channel_origin::text
                ))
              ORDER BY message.created_at DESC, message.id DESC
              LIMIT 1
            )
          ) AS candidate
          ORDER BY candidate.created_at DESC, candidate.id DESC
          LIMIT 1
        ) AS latest ON TRUE
      `
      : [];
    const mensagemPorConversa = new Map(mensagensRecentes.map((message) => [message.conversationId, message]));
    type WindowStates = Awaited<ReturnType<ConversationsService['estadosDasJanelas']>>;
    const estados: WindowStates = new Map();
    for (let offset = 0; offset < pagina.length; offset += 50) {
      const lote = pagina.slice(offset, offset + 50);
      const loteEstados = await this.conversas.estadosDasJanelas(lote.map((c) => ({
        conversationId: c.id, buId, latestMessageOrigin: mensagemPorConversa.get(c.id)?.channelOrigin ?? null,
        latestProviderResourceIdentityId: mensagemPorConversa.get(c.id)?.providerResourceIdentityId ?? null,
      })));
      for (const [id, state] of loteEstados) estados.set(id, state);
    }
    const conversations = pagina.map((c) => {
      const janela = estados.get(c.id);
      const mensagem = mensagemPorConversa.get(c.id);
      return {
        telefone: c.routes[0].contactIdentity.externalPeerId,
        nome_whatsapp: c.displayName,
        status: c.status,
        atendendo: c.attendantName,
        ultima_mensagem: mensagem?.content ?? null,
        ultima_direcao: mensagem?.direction ? (mensagem.direction === 'OUT' ? 'enviada' : 'recebida') : null,
        ultima_em: c.lastMessageAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
        nao_lidas: c.unreadCount,
        janela_aberta: janela?.windowOpen ?? false,
        janela_expira_em: janela?.expiresAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
        envio_disponivel: janela?.available ?? false,
        motivo_indisponibilidade: janela ? janela.reason : 'CANAL_SELECIONADO_INDISPONIVEL',
      };
    });
    return { conta: { id: buId }, conversations, truncado: linhas.length > limite };
  }

  @Get('conversations/:telefone/messages')
  async messages(
    @Param('telefone') telefone: string,
    @Query() q: Record<string, string>,
    @Req() req: Request,
  ) {
    const buId = await this.resolverConta(req, q.account_id);
    const conversa = await this.conversaDoTelefone(buId, telefone);
    const limite = limitePublico(q.limit, 100);

    const mensagens = await this.prisma.message.findMany({
      where: {
        conversationId: conversa.id,
        channelOrigin: { in: ['OFICIAL', 'NAO_OFICIAL'] },
        OR: [
          { providerResourceIdentityId: null },
          { providerResourceIdentity: { is: { businessIdentityId: conversa.businessIdentityId, provider: { in: ['OFICIAL', 'NAO_OFICIAL'] } } } },
        ],
        // `since` permite sync incremental: o parceiro guarda a data da última
        // mensagem copiada e pede só o que veio depois.
        ...(q.since ? { createdAt: { gt: new Date(q.since) } } : {}),
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
      take: limite,
    });

    const janela = await this.conversas.estadoDaJanela(conversa.id, buId);
    return {
      telefone: conversa.contactAddress,
      janela_aberta: janela.aberta,
      envio_disponivel: janela.disponivel,
      motivo_indisponibilidade: janela.motivoIndisponibilidade,
      messages: mensagens.map((m) => ({
        id: m.id,
        direcao: m.direction === 'OUT' ? 'enviada' : 'recebida',
        tipo: m.messageType,
        texto: m.content,
        canal: m.channelOrigin,
        respondido_por: m.authorName,
        // Data SEMPRE em ISO-8601 UTC: API externa não pode entregar formato variável.
        em: m.createdAt.toISOString(),
      })),
    };
  }

  @Post('messages')
  @HttpCode(201)
  async enviar(@Body() body: Record<string, string>, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    const buId = await this.resolverConta(req, body?.account_id);
    const telefone = String(body?.telefone ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '');
    const texto = String(body?.texto ?? '').trim();
    if (!telefone) throw new BadRequestException({ error: 'Informe o telefone.', code: 'TELEFONE_INVALIDO' });
    if (!texto) throw new BadRequestException({ error: 'Informe o texto.', code: 'TEXTO_VAZIO' });
    if (texto.length > 4096) throw new BadRequestException({ error: 'Texto muito longo.', code: 'TEXTO_LONGO' });

    const espera = this.limite.consumir(req.chave!.id, buId);
    if (espera > 0) {
      res.setHeader('Retry-After', String(espera));
      throw new HttpException({ error: 'Ritmo acima do permitido.', code: 'LIMITE_DE_TAXA' }, 429);
    }

    const conversa = await this.conversaOuNova(buId, telefone);
    const atendente = String(body?.atendente ?? '').trim() || req.chave!.nome;
    const m = await this.conversas.responder(conversa.id, buId, texto, { kind: 'PUBLIC', name: atendente });

    return { ok: true, message_id: m.id, canal: m.channelOrigin };
  }

  @Post('conversations/:telefone/claim')
  async claim(@Param('telefone') telefone: string, @Body() body: Record<string, string>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const buId = await this.resolverConta(req, body?.account_id);
    const conversa = await this.conversaDoTelefone(buId, telefone);
    const atendente = String(body?.atendente ?? '').trim() || req.chave!.nome;

    if (conversa.status === 'IN_SERVICE' && conversa.attendantName && conversa.attendantName !== atendente) {
      throw new HttpException(
        { error: `Já está sendo atendida por ${conversa.attendantName}.`, code: 'JA_ATENDIDA' },
        409,
      );
    }
    await this.prisma.conversation.update({
      where: { id: conversa.id },
      data: { status: 'IN_SERVICE', attendantName: atendente, attendantOrigin: 'EXTERNO', attendantUserId: null },
    });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  @Post('conversations/:telefone/release')
  async release(@Param('telefone') telefone: string, @Body() body: Record<string, string>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const buId = await this.resolverConta(req, body?.account_id);
    const conversa = await this.conversaDoTelefone(buId, telefone);
    await this.prisma.conversation.update({
      where: { id: conversa.id },
      data: { status: 'QUEUED', attendantName: null, attendantOrigin: null, attendantUserId: null },
    });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  /** A conta pedida precisa estar no escopo DA CHAVE — e o escopo nulo nunca sai da Mantenedora. */
  private async resolverConta(req: Request, accountId?: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!accountId) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ error: 'Informe o account_id.', code: 'CONTA_NAO_INFORMADA' });
    }
    const permitidas = await this.chaves.busDaChave(req.chave!);
    if (!permitidas.includes(accountId)) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({
        error: 'Esta chave não tem acesso a essa conta.',
        code: 'SEM_ACESSO_A_CONTA',
      });
    }
    return accountId;
  }

  private async whatsappResource(buId: string) {
    const resources = await this.prisma.businessChannelIdentity.findMany({
      where: { buId, platform: 'WHATSAPP' }, select: { id: true, externalResourceId: true, scopeReference: true },
    });
    return resources.length === 1 ? resources[0] : null;
  }

  private async conversaDoTelefone(buId: string, telefone: string) {
    const resource = await this.whatsappResource(buId);
    if (!resource) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'WHATSAPP_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE' });
    const peer = await this.prisma.contactIdentity.findUnique({ where: { buId_platform_namespace_scopeReference_externalPeerId: {
      buId, platform: 'WHATSAPP', namespace: 'PERSON', scopeReference: 'BU', externalPeerId: telefone.replace(/\D/g, ''),
    } }, select: { id: true, contactId: true, externalPeerId: true } });
    const conversa = peer ? await this.prisma.conversation.findFirst({ where: { buId, contactId: peer.contactId,
      contactType: 'PESSOA', routes: { some: { platform: 'WHATSAPP', contactIdentityId: peer.id, businessIdentityId: resource.id } } } }) : null;
    if (!conversa) {
      throw new BadRequestException({ error: 'Conversa não encontrada.', code: 'CONVERSA_NAO_ENCONTRADA' });
    }
    return { ...conversa, businessIdentityId: resource.id, contactAddress: peer!.externalPeerId };
  }

  private async conversaOuNova(buId: string, telefone: string) {
    const contact = telefone.replace(/\D/g, '');
    return this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const peer = await resolveOrCreateContactIdentity(tx, whatsappPeerAddress({ buId, externalPeerId: contact, contactType: 'PESSOA' }));
      const businesses = await tx.businessChannelIdentity.findMany({ where: { buId, platform: 'WHATSAPP' }, select: { id: true, scopeReference: true } });
      if (businesses.length !== 1) throw new BadRequestException({ code: businesses.length ? 'WHATSAPP_RESOURCE_AMBIGUOUS' : 'WHATSAPP_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE' });
      const existing = await tx.conversation.findUnique({ where: { buId_contactId: { buId, contactId: peer.contactId } } });
      if (existing) {
        const route = await tx.conversationRoute.findFirst({ where: { conversationId: existing.id, contactIdentityId: peer.id,
          businessIdentityId: businesses[0].id, platform: 'WHATSAPP' }, select: { id: true } });
        if (!route) throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'WHATSAPP_ROUTE_UNPROVEN' });
        return { ...existing, contactAddress: peer.externalPeerId };
      }
      const conversation = await tx.conversation.create({
        data: { buId, contactId: peer.contactId, contact, contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'IN_SERVICE' },
      });
      await tx.conversationRoute.create({ data: { buId, conversationId: conversation.id, contactId: peer.contactId,
        contactIdentityId: peer.id, platform: 'WHATSAPP', contactScopeReference: peer.scopeReference,
        businessScopeReference: businesses[0].scopeReference, businessIdentityId: businesses[0].id } });
      return { ...conversation, contactAddress: peer.externalPeerId };
    });
  }
}

function periodoDe(de?: string, ate?: string): { de: Date; ate: Date } | null {
  if (!de || !ate) return null;
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(de) || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(ate)) {
    throw new BadRequestException({ error: 'Use de e ate no formato AAAA-MM-DD.', code: 'PERIODO_INVALIDO' });
  }
  return { de: new Date(`${de}T00:00:00.000Z`), ate: new Date(`${ate}T23:59:59.999Z`) };
}

import { Body, Controller, ForbiddenException, GoneException, Headers, HttpCode, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { IncomingService } from '../../domain/inbox/incoming.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { MessageAcceptanceService } from '../../domain/inbox/message-acceptance.service';
import { convergeReceiptVerifiedAttempt } from '../../domain/channels/receipt-attempt-convergence';
import { ServiceUnavailableException, ConflictException } from '@nestjs/common';

/**
 * Webhook do canal não oficial. Autenticação POR ORIGEM (ADR-0006) — e aqui ela
 * é diferente da Meta por um motivo que não é escolha nossa: **a Evolution API
 * não assina nada**. O que resta é segredo no caminho, comparado em tempo
 * constante, com a URL tratada como credencial.
 */
@Controller('webhooks/evolution')
export class EvolutionWebhookController {
  constructor(
    private readonly incoming: IncomingService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly acceptance: MessageAcceptanceService,
  ) {}

  @Post()
  @HttpCode(200)
  async receber(@Headers('x-leadshug-webhook-secret') segredo: string, @Body() body: EvolutionEvent) {
    this.exigirSegredo(segredo);

    const evento = body?.event;
    const instancia = body?.instance;
    if (!evento || !instancia) return { received: true };

    const identity = await this.prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findUnique({
      where: { provider_externalResourceId: { provider: 'NAO_OFICIAL', externalResourceId: instancia } },
      include: { currentChannel: true },
    });
    let canal = identity?.currentChannel ?? null;
    let staged = false;
    if (!canal && identity?.unverifiedStaging && identity.managedLifecycle && identity.cleanupState === 'ACTIVE') {
      const candidate = await this.prisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: {
        buId: identity.buId, type: 'NAO_OFICIAL', evolutionInstanceName: instancia,
        ownNumberVerified: false, verifiedEpoch: null, currentAttemptId: { not: null }, pairingEpoch: { gt: 0 },
      } });
      if (candidate?.currentAttemptId) {
        const attempt = await this.prisma.channelRegistrationAttempt.findFirst({ where: {
          id: candidate.currentAttemptId, channelId: candidate.id, generation: candidate.generation,
          pairingEpoch: candidate.pairingEpoch, stage: { in: ['PAIRING', 'RESERVED_NEVER_CREATED', 'CREATE_AMBIGUOUS', 'IDENTITY_QUARANTINED'] },
        }, select: { id: true } });
        if (attempt) { canal = candidate; staged = true; }
      }
    }
    if (!identity || !canal || canal.evolutionInstanceName !== instancia) return { received: true };
    const context = { providerResourceIdentityId: identity.id, buId: identity.buId, channelId: canal.id, generation: canal.generation, pairingEpoch: canal.pairingEpoch, channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const, stagedExternalResourceId: staged ? instancia : undefined };
    if (canal.ownNumberVerified && canal.verifiedEpoch === canal.pairingEpoch) {
      await this.acceptance.persistVerifiedDiagnostic(context, evento, { instance: instancia, data: body.data });
    } else {
      const rawState = evento === 'connection.update' ? (body.data as ConnectionData | undefined)?.state : undefined;
      const metadata = ['open', 'connecting', 'close'].includes(rawState ?? '') ? rawState : 'PENDING_IDENTITY';
      await this.acceptance.persistCurrentResourceMetadata(context, evento, { instance: instancia, state: metadata }, staged ? instancia : undefined);
    }

    // Os nomes de evento vêm em minúsculo com ponto no payload ENTREGUE, e em
    // maiúsculo com underscore quando são REGISTRADOS. São strings diferentes
    // para a mesma coisa — o parser do Hub já comparou contra o formato errado
    // uma vez (hub-whatsapp/docs/evolution-api-payloads.md).
    switch (evento) {
      case 'messages.upsert':
        if (!canal.ownNumberVerified || canal.verifiedEpoch !== canal.pairingEpoch) throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ code: 'PENDING_IDENTITY' });
        await this.tratarMensagem(context, body.data as UpsertData);
        break;
      case 'connection.update':
        await this.tratarConexao(context, body.data as ConnectionData);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
    return { received: true };
  }

  @Post(':segredo')
  @HttpCode(410)
  legado(): never { throw new GoneException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_PATH_AUTH_RETIRED' }); }

  private exigirSegredo(recebido: string): void {
    const esperado = process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? '';
    if (!esperado) throw new ForbiddenException({ error: 'Webhook não configurado.', code: 'ORIGEM_NAO_VERIFICAVEL' });
    const a = Buffer.from(esperado);
    const b = Buffer.from(recebido ?? '');
    if (a.length !== b.length || !timingSafeEqual(a, b)) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ error: 'Origem não reconhecida.', code: 'ORIGEM_INVALIDA' });
    }
  }

  private async tratarMensagem(context: { buId: string; channelId: string; providerResourceIdentityId: string; generation: number; pairingEpoch: number }, data: UpsertData | undefined): Promise<void> {
    const jid = data?.key?.remoteJid;
    if (!jid) return;

    const ehGrupo = jid.endsWith('@g.us');
    if (!ehGrupo && !jid.endsWith('@s.whatsapp.net')) return; // LID identity is ambiguous; never extract digits from @lid.
    if (!data?.key?.id?.trim()) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'EXTERNAL_MESSAGE_ID_REQUIRED' });
    const daGente = Boolean(data?.key?.fromMe);
    const texto = data?.message?.conversation ?? data?.message?.extendedTextMessage?.text ?? '';

    // `pushName` é o nome de QUEM MANDOU aquela mensagem, não o nome do contato
    // da conversa. Numa mensagem nossa ele é o nome do próprio número — usá-lo
    // aqui é o bug que troca o nome do contato pelo do responsável (corrigido
    // no Hub em 756bd91, e não repetido aqui).
    const nome = !ehGrupo && !daGente ? (data?.pushName ?? null) : null;

    await this.incoming.registrar({
      buId: context.buId,
      canal: 'NAO_OFICIAL',
      // O JID é detalhe de transporte e não entra no domínio (ADR-0009 §1).
      contato: ehGrupo ? jid : jid.split('@')[0],
      ehGrupo,
      nomeExibicao: nome,
      direcao: daGente ? 'OUT' : 'IN',
      tipo: 'TEXTO',
      conteudo: texto,
      externalId: data?.key?.id ?? null,
      providerResourceIdentityId: context.providerResourceIdentityId,
      channelId: context.channelId,
      generation: context.generation,
      pairingEpoch: context.pairingEpoch,
    });
  }

  private async tratarConexao(context: { channelId: string; providerResourceIdentityId: string; buId: string; generation: number; pairingEpoch: number; stagedExternalResourceId?: string }, data: ConnectionData | undefined): Promise<void> {
    const estado = data?.state;
    if (!['open', 'connecting', 'close'].includes(estado ?? '')) return;
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const rows = await tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ id: string }>>`SELECT id FROM provider_resource_identities WHERE id = ${context.providerResourceIdentityId} AND bu_id = ${context.buId} AND (current_channel_id = ${context.channelId} OR (current_channel_id IS NULL AND unverified_staging = TRUE AND external_resource_id = ${context.stagedExternalResourceId ?? ''})) FOR UPDATE`;
      if (!rows.length) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'IDENTITY_NOT_CURRENT' });
      await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM business_units WHERE id = ${context.buId} FOR UPDATE`;
      await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM bu_channels WHERE id = ${context.channelId} FOR UPDATE`;
      const channel = await tx.buChannel.findFirst({ where: { id: context.channelId, buId: context.buId, generation: context.generation, pairingEpoch: context.pairingEpoch, ...(context.stagedExternalResourceId ? { evolutionInstanceName: context.stagedExternalResourceId, ownNumberVerified: false, verifiedEpoch: null, currentAttemptId: { not: null } } : {}) }, select: { ownNumberVerified: true, verifiedEpoch: true, receiptVerifiedAt: true, currentAttemptId: true } });
      if (!channel) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'CHANNEL_GENERATION_STALE' });
      if (context.stagedExternalResourceId) {
        const attempt = await tx.channelRegistrationAttempt.findFirst({ where: { id: channel.currentAttemptId!, channelId: context.channelId, generation: context.generation, pairingEpoch: context.pairingEpoch, stage: { in: ['PAIRING', 'RESERVED_NEVER_CREATED', 'CREATE_AMBIGUOUS', 'IDENTITY_QUARANTINED'] } }, select: { id: true } });
        if (!attempt) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'ATTEMPT_STALE' });
      }
      const ready = estado === 'open' && channel.ownNumberVerified && channel.verifiedEpoch === context.pairingEpoch && Boolean(channel.receiptVerifiedAt);
      const changed = await tx.buChannel.updateMany({
        where: { id: context.channelId, buId: context.buId, generation: context.generation, pairingEpoch: context.pairingEpoch },
        data: { providerConnectionState: estado === 'open' ? 'CONNECTED' : estado === 'connecting' ? 'CONNECTING' : 'DISCONNECTED', status: ready ? 'CONECTADO' : estado === 'close' ? 'DESCONECTADO' : 'CONECTANDO', ...(ready ? { connectedAt: new Date() } : { connectedAt: null }) },
      });
      if (!changed.count) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'CHANNEL_GENERATION_STALE' });
      if (ready && channel.currentAttemptId) {
        const converged = await convergeReceiptVerifiedAttempt(tx, channel.currentAttemptId, context.generation, context.pairingEpoch);
        if (!converged) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'ATTEMPT_STALE' });
      }
    });
  }
}

interface EvolutionEvent {
  event?: string;
  instance?: string;
  data?: unknown;
}
interface UpsertData {
  key?: { remoteJid?: string; fromMe?: boolean; id?: string };
  pushName?: string;
  message?: { conversation?: string; extendedTextMessage?: { text?: string } };
}
interface ConnectionData {
  state?: string;
  wuid?: string;
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { scheduleInstagramIngress, type InstagramIngressWork } from './instagram-ingress-scheduling';

function deferred<T = void>() {
  let resolve!: (value: T | PromiseLike<T>) => void;
  let reject!: (reason?: unknown) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>((ok, fail) => { resolve = ok; reject = fail; });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}

function counter() {
  let value = 0;
  const waiters: Array<{ target: number; resolve: () => void }> = [];
  return {
    get value() { return value; },
    increment() {
      value += 1;
      for (let index = waiters.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
        if (value >= waiters[index].target) waiters.splice(index, 1)[0].resolve();
      }
    },
    waitFor(target: number) {
      if (value >= target) return Promise.resolve();
      return new Promise<void>((resolve) => waiters.push({ target, resolve }));
    },
  };
}

function work(accountId: string, peerId: string, externalMessageId: string, execute: () => Promise<void>): InstagramIngressWork {
  return { accountId, peerId, externalMessageId, execute };
}

describe('Instagram ingress bounded scheduler', () => {
  it('runs at most four peer queues at once', async () => {
    const started = counter();
    const active = counter();
    let inFlight = 0;
    let maximum = 0;
    const gates = Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => deferred<void>());
    const tasks = gates.map((gate, index) => work(`account-${index}`, `peer-${index}`, `mid-${index}`, async () => {
      inFlight += 1;
      maximum = Math.max(maximum, inFlight);
      started.increment();
      await gate.promise;
      inFlight -= 1;
      active.increment();
    }));

    const scheduled = scheduleInstagramIngress(tasks);
    try {
      await started.waitFor(4);
      expect(started.value).toBe(4);
      expect(maximum).toBe(4);
      for (let index = 0; index < 4; index += 1) gates[index].resolve();
      await active.waitFor(4);
      await started.waitFor(8);
      expect(maximum).toBe(4);
      for (let index = 4; index < 8; index += 1) gates[index].resolve();
      await scheduled;
      expect(inFlight).toBe(0);
      expect(maximum).toBe(4);
    } finally {
      for (const gate of gates) gate.resolve();
      await Promise.allSettled([scheduled]);
    }
  });

  it('keeps each account/peer queue ordered while independent peers complete in reverse order', async () => {
    const order: string[] = [];
    const started = counter();
    const finished = counter();
    const firstPeer = deferred<void>();
    const secondPeer = deferred<void>();
    const thirdPeer = deferred<void>();
    const tasks = [
      work('account-a', 'peer-a', 'a-1', async () => { order.push('a1:start'); started.increment(); await firstPeer.promise; order.push('a1:end'); finished.increment(); }),
      work('account-a', 'peer-a', 'a-2', async () => { order.push('a2:start'); started.increment(); order.push('a2:end'); finished.increment(); }),
      work('account-b', 'peer-b', 'b-1', async () => { order.push('b1:start'); started.increment(); await secondPeer.promise; order.push('b1:end'); finished.increment(); }),
      work('account-c', 'peer-c', 'c-1', async () => { order.push('c1:start'); started.increment(); await thirdPeer.promise; order.push('c1:end'); finished.increment(); }),
    ];
    const scheduled = scheduleInstagramIngress(tasks);
    try {
      await started.waitFor(3);
      expect(order).toContain('a1:start');
      expect(order).not.toContain('a2:start');

      thirdPeer.resolve();
      await finished.waitFor(1);
      expect(order).toContain('c1:end');
      expect(order).not.toContain('a1:end');
      secondPeer.resolve();
      firstPeer.resolve();
      await scheduled;
      expect(order.indexOf('c1:end')).toBeLessThan(order.indexOf('a1:end'));
      expect(order.indexOf('a1:end')).toBeLessThan(order.indexOf('a2:start'));
      expect(order.indexOf('a2:start')).toBeLessThan(order.indexOf('a2:end'));
    } finally {
      firstPeer.resolve();
      secondPeer.resolve();
      thirdPeer.resolve();
      await Promise.allSettled([scheduled]);
    }
  });

  it('uses original flat serial order when one account/message key is assigned to different peers', async () => {
    const order: string[] = [];
    const started = counter();
    const gates = [deferred<void>(), deferred<void>(), deferred<void>(), deferred<void>()];
    const tasks = [
      work('account-a', 'peer-one', 'same-mid', async () => { order.push('one:start'); started.increment(); await gates[0].promise; order.push('one:end'); }),
      work('account-a', 'peer-two', 'same-mid', async () => { order.push('two:start'); started.increment(); await gates[1].promise; order.push('two:end'); }),
      work('account-a', 'peer-one', 'different-mid', async () => { order.push('one-later:start'); started.increment(); await gates[2].promise; order.push('one-later:end'); }),
      work('account-b', 'peer-three', 'same-mid', async () => { order.push('three:start'); started.increment(); await gates[3].promise; order.push('three:end'); }),
    ];
    const scheduled = scheduleInstagramIngress(tasks);
    try {
      await started.waitFor(1);
      expect(order).toEqual(['one:start']);
      gates[0].resolve();
      await started.waitFor(2);
      expect(order).toEqual(['one:start', 'one:end', 'two:start']);
      gates[1].resolve();
      await started.waitFor(3);
      expect(order).toEqual(['one:start', 'one:end', 'two:start', 'two:end', 'one-later:start']);
      gates[2].resolve();
      await started.waitFor(4);
      expect(order).toEqual(['one:start', 'one:end', 'two:start', 'two:end', 'one-later:start', 'one-later:end', 'three:start']);
      gates[3].resolve();
      await scheduled;
      expect(order).toEqual(['one:start', 'one:end', 'two:start', 'two:end', 'one-later:start', 'one-later:end', 'three:start', 'three:end']);
    } finally {
      for (const gate of gates) gate.resolve();
      await Promise.allSettled([scheduled]);
    }
  });

  it('allows the same provider message key under different accounts to run independently', async () => {
    const started = counter();
    const gates = [deferred<void>(), deferred<void>()];
    const tasks = [
      work('account-a', 'same-peer', 'same-mid', async () => { started.increment(); await gates[0].promise; }),
      work('account-b', 'same-peer', 'same-mid', async () => { started.increment(); await gates[1].promise; }),
    ];
    const scheduled = scheduleInstagramIngress(tasks);
    try {
      await started.waitFor(2);
      expect(started.value).toBe(2);
      gates[1].resolve();
      gates[0].resolve();
      await scheduled;
    } finally {
      for (const gate of gates) gate.resolve();
      await Promise.allSettled([scheduled]);
    }
  });

  it('stops queued work on failure, drains started work, then rejects with the original error', async () => {
    const started = counter();
    const completed = counter();
    const failureGate = deferred<void>();
    const failureObserved = deferred<void>();
    const activeGates = Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => deferred<void>());
    const failure = new Error('synthetic acceptance failure');
    const tasks = [
      work('account-0', 'peer-0', 'mid-0', async () => {
        started.increment();
        try {
          await failureGate.promise;
        } catch (error) {
          failureObserved.resolve();
          throw error;
        }
        throw failure;
      }),
      ...activeGates.map((gate, index) => work(`account-${index + 1}`, `peer-${index + 1}`, `mid-${index + 1}`, async () => {
        started.increment(); await gate.promise; completed.increment();
      })),
      ...Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, index) => work(`queued-account-${index}`, `queued-peer-${index}`, `queued-mid-${index}`, async () => {
        started.increment(); completed.increment();
      })),
    ];
    let completedAtRejection = -1;
    const scheduled = scheduleInstagramIngress(tasks).catch((error: unknown) => {
      completedAtRejection = completed.value;
      throw error;
    });
    try {
      await started.waitFor(4);
      failureGate.reject(failure);
      await failureObserved.promise;
      for (const gate of activeGates) gate.resolve();
      await expect(scheduled).rejects.toBe(failure);
      expect(started.value).toBe(4);
      expect(completedAtRejection).toBe(3);
    } finally {
      failureGate.reject(failure);
      for (const gate of activeGates) gate.resolve();
      await Promise.allSettled([scheduled]);
    }
  });

  it('accepts an empty batch without scheduling work', async () => {
    await expect(scheduleInstagramIngress([])).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  });
});

## api-app/src/surfaces/webhooks/instagram-ingress-scheduling.ts | sha256 dc1801e9935c4db6e9648e7d4a00d84303b5cad7a98539d6c4f84fa8c2923986 | FULL BODY

```
export interface InstagramIngressWork {
  readonly accountId: string;
  readonly peerId: string;
  readonly externalMessageId: string;
  readonly execute: () => Promise<void>;
}

const MAX_PEER_WORKERS = 4;

/** Execute one signed Instagram request in bounded, peer-ordered queues. */
export async function scheduleInstagramIngress(work: readonly InstagramIngressWork[]): Promise<void> {
  if (work.length === 0) return;

  const keyPeers = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const item of work) {
    const messageKey = JSON.stringify([item.accountId, item.externalMessageId]);
    const priorPeer = keyPeers.get(messageKey);
    if (priorPeer !== undefined && priorPeer !== item.peerId) {
      await executeFlatSerial(work);
      return;
    }
    keyPeers.set(messageKey, item.peerId);
  }

  const queueByPeer = new Map<string, InstagramIngressWork[]>();
  for (const item of work) {
    const peerKey = JSON.stringify([item.accountId, item.peerId]);
    const queue = queueByPeer.get(peerKey);
    if (queue) queue.push(item);
    else queueByPeer.set(peerKey, [item]);
  }
  const queues = [...queueByPeer.values()];
  let nextQueue = 0;
  let stopped = false;
  let firstFailure: unknown;

  const worker = async (): Promise<void> => {
    while (!stopped) {
      const queueIndex = nextQueue;
      nextQueue += 1;
      if (queueIndex >= queues.length) return;
      for (const item of queues[queueIndex]) {
        if (stopped) return;
        try {
          await item.execute();
        } catch (error) {
          if (!stopped) {
            stopped = true;
            firstFailure = error;
          }
          return;
        }
      }
    }
  };

  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(MAX_PEER_WORKERS, queues.length) }, () => worker()));
  if (stopped) throw firstFailure;
}

async function executeFlatSerial(work: readonly InstagramIngressWork[]): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of work) await item.execute();
}

import { BadRequestException, Controller, ForbiddenException, Get, HttpCode, PayloadTooLargeException, Post, Query, Req, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { RawBodyRequest } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { ContactIdentityAddress } from '../../domain/inbox/contact-identity';
import { MessageAcceptanceService } from '../../domain/inbox/message-acceptance.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { instagramConfig } from '../../integrations/instagram/instagram-http.client';
import { scheduleInstagramIngress, type InstagramIngressWork } from './instagram-ingress-scheduling';

const MAX_UPDATES = 1000;
const MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_AGE = 24 * 60 * 60_000;

@Controller('webhooks/instagram')
export class InstagramWebhookController {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService, private readonly acceptance: MessageAcceptanceService) {}

  @Get()
  challenge(@Query() query: Record<string, string>) {
    const config = instagramConfig();
    if (config && query['hub.mode'] === 'subscribe' && query['hub.verify_token'] === config.webhookVerifyToken
      && typeof query['hub.challenge'] === 'string' && query['hub.challenge'].length <= 256) return query['hub.challenge'];
    throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_CHALLENGE_INVALID' });
  }

  @Post()
  @HttpCode(200)
  async receive(@Req() req: RawBodyRequest<Request>) {
    const config = instagramConfig();
    const raw = req.rawBody ?? (Buffer.isBuffer(req.body) ? req.body : undefined);
    if (!config || !raw) throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_UNVERIFIABLE' });
    if (raw.byteLength > MAX_BYTES) throw new PayloadTooLargeException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_BODY_TOO_LARGE' });
    this.verifySignature(req, raw, config.webhookAppSecret);
    let payload: InstagramWebhookBody;
    try { payload = JSON.parse(raw.toString('utf8')) as InstagramWebhookBody; } catch { throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_INVALID' }); }
    if (!payload || payload.object !== 'instagram' || !Array.isArray(payload.entry)) throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_INVALID' });
    for (const entry of payload.entry) {
      if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object' || Array.isArray(entry)
        || (entry.id !== undefined && typeof entry.id !== 'string')
        || (entry.messaging !== undefined && !Array.isArray(entry.messaging))) {
        throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_INVALID' });
      }
    }
    const updates = payload.entry.flatMap((entry) => Array.isArray(entry.messaging) ? entry.messaging : []);
    if (updates.length > MAX_UPDATES) throw new PayloadTooLargeException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_BATCH_TOO_LARGE' });
    // Validate the whole envelope's shape and count before the first domain write.
    for (const event of updates) {
      if (!event || typeof event !== 'object' || Array.isArray(event)
        || !event.sender || typeof event.sender !== 'object' || Array.isArray(event.sender)
        || !event.recipient || typeof event.recipient !== 'object' || Array.isArray(event.recipient)
        || typeof event.sender.id !== 'string' || event.sender.id.length === 0 || event.sender.id.length > 256
        || typeof event.recipient.id !== 'string' || event.recipient.id.length === 0 || event.recipient.id.length > 256) {
        throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_INVALID' });
      }
      const message = event.message;
      if (message !== undefined && (!message || typeof message !== 'object' || Array.isArray(message))) {
        throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_INVALID' });
      }
      if (message && typeof message === 'object') {
        if (['is_echo', 'is_self', 'is_deleted'].some((field) => field in message && typeof message[field as keyof typeof message] !== 'boolean')) {
          throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_INVALID' });
        }
        if (message.mid !== undefined && (typeof message.mid !== 'string' || message.mid.length === 0 || message.mid.length > 256)) {
          throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_INVALID' });
        }
        if (message.text !== undefined && typeof message.text !== 'string') throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_INVALID' });
        if (typeof message.text === 'string' && message.text.length > 1000) throw new PayloadTooLargeException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_TEXT_TOO_LARGE' });
      }
      if (message && typeof message === 'object' && !Array.isArray(message)
        && message.is_echo !== true && message.is_self !== true && message.is_deleted !== true
        && message.text !== undefined
        && (typeof message.mid !== 'string' || !message.mid || typeof message.text !== 'string' || !message.text)) {
        throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_INVALID' });
      }
    }
    // A supported text event needs the account ID of its own entry; preflight
    // every such entry before any receipt, identity, or inbox effect occurs.
    for (const entry of payload.entry) {
      for (const event of Array.isArray(entry.messaging) ? entry.messaging : []) {
        const message = event.message;
        if (!message || typeof message !== 'object' || message.is_echo === true || message.is_self === true || message.is_deleted === true
          || typeof message.mid !== 'string' || message.mid.length === 0 || typeof message.text !== 'string' || message.text.length === 0) continue;
        if (typeof entry.id !== 'string' || entry.id.length === 0 || entry.id.length > 256) {

    for (const entry of payload.entry) {

        if (!message || typeof message !== 'object' || message.is_echo === true || message.is_self === true || message.is_deleted === true
          || typeof message.mid !== 'string' || !message.mid || typeof message.text !== 'string' || message.text.length === 0) continue;
        if (typeof entry.id !== 'string' || event.recipient.id !== entry.id || event.sender.id === entry.id) continue;
        const accountId = entry.id;
        const peerId = event.sender.id;
        const externalMessageId = message.mid;
        const messageText = message.text;
        work.push({ accountId, peerId, externalMessageId, execute: async () => {
          const identity = await this.prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findUnique({
            where: { provider_externalResourceId: { provider: 'INSTAGRAM', externalResourceId: accountId } },
            include: { currentChannel: true, businessIdentity: true },
          });
          const channel = identity?.currentChannel;
          const mappedAwaitingReceipt = Boolean(channel && channel.providerConnectionState === 'MAPPED_PENDING_SUBSCRIPTION'
            && channel.status === 'CONECTANDO' && await this.prisma.channelCredential.findFirst({ where: {
              channelId: channel.id, buId: identity!.buId, provider: 'INSTAGRAM', generation: channel.generation,
              OR: [{ expiresAt: null }, { expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } }],
            }, select: { id: true } }));
          if (!identity || !channel || identity.currentChannelId !== channel.id || channel.type !== 'INSTAGRAM'
            || channel.businessIdentityId !== identity.businessIdentityId || identity.businessIdentity?.platform !== 'INSTAGRAM'
            || !channel.ownNumberVerified || channel.verifiedEpoch !== channel.pairingEpoch
            || (!mappedAwaitingReceipt && !['SUBSCRIBED_PENDING_RECEIPT', 'SUBSCRIBED'].includes(channel.providerConnectionState))) {
            throw new ForbiddenException({ code: 'INSTAGRAM_RESOURCE_NOT_READY' });
          }
          const address: ContactIdentityAddress = {
            buId: identity.buId, platform: 'INSTAGRAM', namespace: 'INSTAGRAM_LOGIN',
            scopeReference: identity.businessIdentity.scopeReference,
            externalPeerId: peerId, displayName: typeof event.sender.username === 'string' ? event.sender.username.slice(0, 128) : null,
          };
          const timestamp = typeof event.timestamp === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(event.timestamp) ? event.timestamp : null;
          const now = Date.now();
          const qualifiedAt = timestamp !== null && timestamp > 0 && timestamp <= now + 5 * 60_000 && timestamp >= now - MAX_AGE
            ? new Date(timestamp) : null;
          await this.acceptance.accept({
            providerResourceIdentityId: identity.id, buId: identity.buId, channelId: channel.id,
            generation: channel.generation, pairingEpoch: channel.pairingEpoch, channelOrigin: 'INSTAGRAM',
            externalMessageId, contact: peerId, contactType: 'PESSOA', displayName: address.displayName,
            direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO', content: messageText,
            instagramInboundAt: qualifiedAt, contactAddress: address,
          });
        } });
      }
    }
    await scheduleInstagramIngress(work);
    return 'EVENT_RECEIVED';
  }

  private verifySignature(req: Request, raw: Buffer, secret: string) {
    const signature = req.headers['x-hub-signature-256'];
    if (typeof signature !== 'string' || !/^sha256=[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(signature)) throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'ASSINATURA_INVALIDA' });
    const expected = `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', secret).update(raw).digest('hex')}`;
    const a = Buffer.from(expected); const b = Buffer.from(signature);
    if (a.length !== b.length || !timingSafeEqual(a, b)) throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'ASSINATURA_INVALIDA' });
  }
}

interface InstagramEntry { id?: string; messaging?: InstagramMessagingEvent[]; }
interface InstagramMessagingEvent {
  sender: { id: string; username?: string };
  recipient: { id: string };
  timestamp?: number;
  message?: { mid?: string; text?: string; is_echo?: boolean; is_self?: boolean; is_deleted?: boolean };
}

import { Controller, ForbiddenException, Get, HttpCode, Post, Query, Req, ServiceUnavailableException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { RawBodyRequest } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { IncomingService, MensagemRecebida } from '../../domain/inbox/incoming.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { MessageAcceptanceService } from '../../domain/inbox/message-acceptance.service';
import { qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp } from '../../domain/inbox/channel-window-policy';

/**
 * Webhook do canal oficial. Autenticação POR ORIGEM (ADR-0006): a Meta assina o
 * corpo com o app secret, e é isso que provamos aqui.
 *
 * Fecha o risco S2: hoje, nos dois sistemas antigos, o POST do webhook não é
 * verificado — qualquer um que alcance a URL injeta mensagem.
 */
@Controller('webhooks/meta')
export class MetaWebhookController {
  constructor(
    private readonly incoming: IncomingService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly acceptance: MessageAcceptanceService,
  ) {}

  /** Verificação do endpoint, feita pela Meta ao cadastrar a URL. */
  @Get()
  verificar(@Query() q: Record<string, string>): string {
    const esperado = process.env.WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN ?? '';
    if (esperado && q['hub.mode'] === 'subscribe' && q['hub.verify_token'] === esperado) {
      return q['hub.challenge'] ?? '';
    }
    throw new ForbiddenException();
  }

  @Post()
  @HttpCode(200)
  async receber(@Req() req: RawBodyRequest<Request>): Promise<string> {
    this.exigirAssinatura(req);

    const body = req.body as MetaWebhookBody;
    for (const entry of (body?.entry ?? []).slice(0, 100)) {
      for (const change of (entry.changes ?? []).slice(0, 100)) {
        if (change.field !== 'messages') continue;
        await this.tratarMensagens(change.value ?? {});
      }
    }

    // A Meta reentrega o que não recebeu 200. Erro de processamento nosso não
    // pode virar reentrega infinita — o evento cru já está gravado.
    return 'EVENT_RECEIVED';
  }

  /**
   * A assinatura é verificada sobre os BYTES BRUTOS. Sobre JSON reserializado
   * ela falharia (ou, pior, aceitaria payload alterado com a mesma semântica).
   */
  private exigirAssinatura(req: RawBodyRequest<Request>): void {
    const segredo = process.env.META_APP_SECRET ?? '';
    // Ausência de configuração é NEGAÇÃO, nunca liberação: sem segredo, não há
    // como provar origem, e aceitar seria reabrir o S2 por conveniência.
    if (!segredo) throw new ForbiddenException({ error: 'Webhook não configurado.', code: 'ORIGEM_NAO_VERIFICAVEL' });

    const cabecalho = req.headers['x-hub-signature-256'];
    const bruto = req.rawBody;
    if (typeof cabecalho !== 'string' || !bruto) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ error: 'Assinatura ausente.', code: 'ASSINATURA_INVALIDA' });
    }

    const esperada = 'sha256=' + createHmac('sha256', segredo).update(bruto).digest('hex');
    const a = Buffer.from(esperada);
    const b = Buffer.from(cabecalho);
    if (a.length !== b.length || !timingSafeEqual(a, b)) {
      throw new ForbiddenException({ error: 'Assinatura inválida.', code: 'ASSINATURA_INVALIDA' });
    }
  }

  private async tratarMensagens(value: MetaMessagesValue): Promise<void> {
    const phoneNumberId = value.metadata?.phone_number_id;
    if (!phoneNumberId) return;
    const identity = await this.prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findUnique({
      where: { provider_externalResourceId: { provider: 'OFICIAL', externalResourceId: phoneNumberId } },
      include: { currentChannel: true },
    });
    const channel = identity?.currentChannel;
    if (!identity || !channel || channel.phoneNumberId !== phoneNumberId) return;
    const context = {
      providerResourceIdentityId: identity.id, buId: identity.buId, channelId: channel.id,
      generation: channel.generation, pairingEpoch: channel.pairingEpoch, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL' as const,
    };
    if (!channel.ownNumberVerified || channel.verifiedEpoch !== channel.pairingEpoch) {
      await this.acceptance.persistCurrentResourceMetadata(context, 'meta.webhook', { phoneNumberId, field: 'messages', state: 'PENDING_IDENTITY' });
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ code: 'PENDING_IDENTITY' });
    }
    const redactedEvent = { phoneNumberId, value };
    await this.acceptance.persistVerifiedDiagnostic(context, 'meta.webhook', redactedEvent);

    const nome = value.contacts?.[0]?.profile?.name ?? null;

    for (const msg of (value.messages ?? []).slice(0, 100)) {
      if (typeof msg.id !== 'string' || !msg.id.trim()) continue;
      const rawContact = typeof msg.from === 'string' ? msg.from : '';
      // This slice supports WhatsApp phone contacts only. Opaque Meta IDs
      // (including BSUID-style identifiers) are rejected until their mapping
      // contract is implemented; never turn letters into another phone.
      if (!/^\+?[1-9]\d{7,14}$/.test(rawContact)) continue;
      const contact = rawContact.replace(/^\+/, '');
      await this.incoming.registrar({
        buId: identity.buId,
        canal: 'OFICIAL',
        contato: contact,
        ehGrupo: false,
        nomeExibicao: nome,
        direcao: 'IN',
        tipo: tipoDaMensagem(msg.type),
        conteudo: conteudoDaMensagem(msg),
        officialInboundAt: qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp(msg.timestamp),
        externalId: msg.id,
        providerResourceIdentityId: identity.id,
        channelId: channel.id,
        generation: channel.generation,
        pairingEpoch: channel.pairingEpoch,
      });
    }
  }
}

export function tipoDaMensagem(tipo?: string): MensagemRecebida['tipo'] {
  switch (tipo) {
    case 'text':
    case 'button':
    case 'interactive':
      return 'TEXTO';
    case 'image':
      return 'IMAGEM';
    case 'audio':
      return 'AUDIO';
    case 'video':
      return 'VIDEO';
    case 'document':
      return 'DOCUMENTO';
    default:
      return 'OUTRO';
  }
}

/** A v1 registra o tipo e não baixa arquivo (ADR-0009 §6). */
export function conteudoDaMensagem(msg: MetaMessage): string {
  if (msg.type === 'text') return msg.text?.body ?? '';
  if (msg.type === 'button') return msg.button?.text ?? '';
  if (msg.type === 'interactive') {
    return msg.interactive?.button_reply?.title ?? msg.interactive?.list_reply?.title ?? '[interativo]';
  }
  return `[${msg.type ?? 'mensagem'}]`;
}

interface MetaWebhookBody {
  entry?: { changes?: { field?: string; value?: MetaMessagesValue }[] }[];
}
interface MetaMessagesValue {
  metadata?: { phone_number_id?: string };
  contacts?: { profile?: { name?: string } }[];
  messages?: MetaMessage[];
}
export interface MetaMessage {
  id?: string;
  from?: string;
  timestamp?: string | number;
  type?: string;
  text?: { body?: string };
  button?: { text?: string };
  interactive?: { button_reply?: { title?: string }; list_reply?: { title?: string } };
}

```
